scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' INT TERM; npm run dev:next & npm run dev:twine & wait
scripts.dev:twine: CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=1 CHOKIDAR_INTERVAL=1000 npm --prefix twinejs-integrated run start
scripts.build: python3 public/craft/build-recipe-viewer.py && npm run build:twine && next build
scripts.build:twine: npm --prefix twinejs-integrated install && npm --prefix twinejs-integrated run build:web && rm -rf public/twine && cp -r twinejs-integrated/dist/web public/twine
